text:
alex: Quick sync Tues 11am PT to finalize gateway adapter cert checklist and marketplace bundle lint. Need to pick: keep `model_alias` or migrate to `model_family`? Please RSVP.

maria: I vote migrate but only with a 6-month fallback shim and clear migration notes in the manifest RFC. Also require SBOM + vuln scan in bundles.

sam: I'll draft a compatibility matrix mapping alias->family and include migration steps for LangChain/LlamaIndex adapters. ETA Wed.

devon: Partner Eng will add SBOM and signature checks to rw-validate. Local demo CLI: `rw-validate bundle.tgz --checks sbom,signing,smoke`. Will open PR with sample bundles.

lina: SI request: include cutover runbook (egress rules, KMS mapping, health probes) and a rollback recipe. We'll bring a 1-page runbook to the meeting.

partner-bot: Reminder: "Adapter bundle lint & cert" Tue 11:00 PT (organizer: alex).

alex: Action items: sam (compat matrix), devon (validator PR + demo), maria (coordinate partner invites & embargo timing). If you can't make it, post availability here. Thanks.
